user.title: Configure tablet dashboard
user.description: Choose dashboard entities. If the tablet was not discovered, enter its private IP while the updated app is visible. Across VLANs allow TCP 8787; multicast discovery needs an mDNS reflector. Leave IP empty for existing manual tablet setup. Pairing still requires HTTPS HA authorization on the tablet.

data.name: Tablet name
data.music: Music shortcuts (list of title, uri, type objects)
data.journey_endpoint: Optional fixed HTTPS Journey adapter endpoint

confirm.title: Discovered Hearthline tablet
confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Installation ID: {tablet_id}. Compare it with the tablet Settings screen. Discovery is untrusted identification, not pairing. Continue to choose dashboard entities, then authorize pairing on the tablet.

error.invalid_selection: Choose existing supported entities and valid bounded settings.
error.cannot_connect: Could not identify the tablet. Use its private IP, keep the updated app visible with discovery enabled, and allow TCP 8787 between VLANs.

abort.already_configured: This tablet is already configured. Use its existing dashboard entry.
